svg.title: WireGuard: a 148-byte Handshake Initiation
svg.desc: The Handshake Initiation of frame 1 of wireshark_wireguard-ping-tcp.pcap, 32 bits per row: type 1, three reserved zero bytes, the sender index 0x30d037d8 in little-endian, then fixed-size fields the crate borrows without decrypting, the 32-byte unencrypted ephemeral, the 48-byte encrypted static, the 28-byte encrypted timestamp, mac1 and a zero mac2; WireGuardPacket keeps the type, the reserved bytes and a HandshakeInitiation message.
